meta.name: GetHired Resource Library — Bank
meta.note: Static, role-tagged, category-tagged free resource library (V4-P5). Every entry is a genuinely free (no paywall, no 'free trial') resource — a Researcher subagent verified each URL with a live search/fetch before inclusion, and excluded several plausible-but-actually-paywalled or dead links found during that pass (ISC2 CC's closed free-voucher program, Coursera's Google Cert 7-day-trial-then-paid, TCM Security's trimmed free YouTube cut of a paid course, eJPT/INE's inconsistent free status, a dead SANS Reading Room link, and a misattributed awesome-pentest repo). Role tagging follows the same convention as lib/mcq/lib/projectIdeas: every resource includes whichever role track(s) it's genuinely central to, generalist included wherever the resource is broadly useful rather than narrowly track-specific.
meta.soft_skills_note: soft_skills is the thinnest category (one entry) because most 'free' report-writing/communication resources found during research were paywalled or login-gated — left thin rather than padded with a weak fit, consistent with this project's honesty-first framing.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10
resources.description: The industry-standard list of the ten most critical web application security risks, maintained by the nonprofit OWASP Foundation — foundational reading for understanding what attackers actually exploit.

resources.title: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
resources.description: 90+ concise, authoritative cheat sheets on specific application security topics (auth, input validation, session management, etc.) written by security practitioners.

resources.title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy
resources.description: A completely free, continuously updated training center with interactive hands-on labs covering every major web vulnerability class, built by the makers of Burp Suite.

resources.title: Burp Suite Documentation
resources.description: Official documentation for Burp Suite Community Edition, the free industry-standard tool for manual web app penetration testing.

resources.title: MITRE ATT&CK
resources.description: A free, globally-used knowledge base of real-world adversary tactics and techniques, giving analysts and pentesters a shared vocabulary for describing attacker behavior.

resources.title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF 2.0)
resources.description: The US government's free, widely-adopted framework for understanding, assessing, and communicating cybersecurity risk — commonly referenced in interviews and job postings.

resources.title: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 2 — Computer Security Incident Handling Guide
resources.description: NIST's free official guide defining the standard incident response lifecycle (prepare, detect, contain, eradicate, recover) that most SOC processes are modeled on.

resources.title: Professor Messer's CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701) Course
resources.description: A complete, free 15-hour video course covering every Security+ exam objective — the most widely recommended free Security+ prep resource.

resources.title: Professor Messer's CompTIA Network+ (N10-009) Course
resources.description: A free, complete video course (~13 hours) covering every Network+ exam objective across networking concepts, implementation, operations, security, and troubleshooting.

resources.title: Cisco Networking Academy — Networking Basics
resources.description: A free, self-paced Cisco NetAcad course teaching foundational networking concepts with hands-on Packet Tracer labs — a gentle on-ramp before CCNA-track material.

resources.title: Cisco Networking Academy — CCNA: Introduction to Networks
resources.description: Free, first course in Cisco's official 3-course CCNA prep series, covering IP addressing, subnetting, switching, and routing fundamentals with graded labs.

resources.title: TryHackMe Free Rooms
resources.description: TryHackMe's official directory of rooms accessible on the free tier, including the beginner-friendly Pre Security path covering networking, Linux, and web fundamentals through guided hands-on exercises.

resources.title: TryHackMe — Writing Pentest Reports
resources.description: A free room teaching how to write client-ready penetration test reports: structuring findings, giving business context, and writing actionable remediation guidance for different audiences.

resources.title: Hack The Box — Starting Point
resources.description: HTB's free, guided track of beginner machines (three progressive tiers) that walks total newcomers through their first real penetration testing targets step by step.

resources.title: Hack The Box Academy — Free Fundamentals Modules
resources.description: HTB's own roundup of the free HTB Academy Fundamentals modules (Intro to Networking, Linux Fundamentals, Windows Fundamentals, Incident Handling Process, Web Requests), unlocked at no cost on signup.

resources.title: CyberChef
resources.description: GCHQ's free, browser-based 'Cyber Swiss Army Knife' for decoding, hashing, and analyzing data — a staple tool for CTFs, log analysis, and malware triage that runs with zero install.

resources.title: Nmap Reference Guide
resources.description: The official, free reference documentation for Nmap covering every scan type, timing option, and scripting engine feature — essential reading for anyone doing network/port reconnaissance.

resources.title: Wireshark User's Guide
resources.description: The official free documentation for Wireshark, the standard packet-capture and traffic-analysis tool used constantly in SOC/network security work.

resources.title: Metasploit Unleashed
resources.description: A free, in-depth Metasploit Framework course from Offensive Security (no registration required) covering exploitation, post-exploitation, and pivoting techniques.

resources.title: Malware-Traffic-Analysis.net Training Exercises
resources.description: Hundreds of free, real packet captures (pcaps) with guided questions for practicing network traffic and malware infection analysis — a favorite for building SOC-analyst pcap skills.

resources.title: LetsDefend — SOC Fundamentals
resources.description: A free course explaining how a SOC operates and the core tools (log management, EDR, SOAR) a Tier-1 SOC analyst uses day to day.

resources.title: CyberDefenders — Blue Team CTF Challenges
resources.description: A free catalog of gamified, real-world blue-team scenarios (log analysis, digital forensics, threat hunting) that let entry-level candidates practice actual SOC/DFIR investigation skills.

resources.title: SANS Internet Storm Center
resources.description: A free, community-run daily threat diary and alert service run by volunteer incident handlers, useful for building the habit of following current attack trends.

resources.title: Splunk Free Training Courses
resources.description: Splunk's own free, self-paced introductory courses on the most widely-used commercial SIEM platform — directly relevant to log analysis and SOC tooling.

resources.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python
resources.description: Al Sweigart's free, beginner-friendly online book teaching practical Python scripting — a common on-ramp for security automation and tooling scripts.

resources.title: Microsoft Learn — Get Started with Windows PowerShell
resources.description: Microsoft's own free, self-paced learning path for PowerShell fundamentals, the primary scripting tool for Windows administration and security tasks.

resources.title: PayloadsAllTheThings
resources.description: A massive, free, actively-maintained GitHub collection of exploitation payloads and bypass techniques organized by vulnerability class — a go-to practical reference during web app testing.

resources.title: HackTricks
resources.description: A free, extensive wiki documenting real-world pentesting methodology, tool usage, and privilege-escalation tricks contributed by the security community.

resources.title: SubnettingPractice.com
resources.description: A free, randomized subnetting question generator plus subnet/VLSM calculators — the classic drilling tool for mastering IPv4/IPv6 subnetting for CCNA/Network+.

resources.title: NetworkChuck (YouTube)
resources.description: A free, high-energy YouTube channel with beginner-friendly series on networking, Linux, and IT certifications (Cisco, CompTIA) aimed squarely at people breaking into IT/security.

resources.title: John Hammond (YouTube)
resources.description: A free YouTube channel with CTF walkthroughs, malware analysis, and security scripting content from a working security researcher — good exposure to real analyst workflows.

resources.title: IppSec (YouTube)
resources.description: A free YouTube channel of detailed, methodical Hack The Box machine walkthroughs, widely used by OSCP/pentest candidates to learn real exploitation methodology.

resources.title: awesome-pentest (GitHub)
resources.description: A large, actively-maintained curated list of penetration testing tools, resources, and references spanning recon, exploitation, forensics, and more.

resources.title: awesome-incident-response (GitHub)
resources.description: A curated, actively-maintained list of free tools and resources specifically for incident response and digital forensics work.

resources.title: freeCodeCamp — Information Security Certification
resources.description: A free, fully interactive certification from the freeCodeCamp nonprofit that has learners build a secure web app and write an Nmap-style port scanner in Python, hands-on and code-graded.
